deposit.note: Fill these in after depositing, then commit. Distinct from the ~1 GB Step-2 snapshot whose deposit run_manifest.json defers to project freeze: that one is deferred because it will still change, while these seven are July collection outputs behind a sealed H1 and a sealed model, and will not. Until a URL exists here, the R40 workflow cannot run at all.

verification.what_this_proves: Every deposited byte hashes to the value pinned before the upload existed.

excluded.consequence: npm_range_h2.py --self-test resolves every emitted pointer against the raw window record it points into, and cannot run on the runner without these. R40 therefore does NOT re-establish pointer resolvability online; it inherits that from the offline suite, and says so.

h1_coverage_stats.json.hash_already_committed_in: NOTHING - unpinned before R40, which is why it is pinned here
h1_coverage_stats.json.purpose: carries snapshot_T, the single day availability is judged against; read by build_h2_query_ledger.snapshot_T()

nvd_full_index.jsonl.gz.purpose: NVD back-query index; per the identity contract it never enters an analysis denominator, but the model does not rebuild byte-identically without it

osv_full_index.jsonl.gz.purpose: OSV back-query index; also read by score_h2 to decide npm ecosystem membership

sample_ghsa.jsonl.gz.purpose: GHSA half of the frozen cohort

sample_nvd.jsonl.gz.purpose: NVD half of the 29,477-record frozen cohort; identity and assertion input to build_unified_v3

sample_osv.jsonl.gz.purpose: OSV half of the frozen cohort

what_this_is: Exactly the files a GitHub runner must fetch before it can rebuild unified_model_v3 and run the decision chain. The workflow verifies each download against the sha256 here, and refuses to build on a mismatch.
